original_value: With its smart grey and red finish, Cruzer Force USB Flash Drive 32GB looks good from the moment you see it. Its outer casing is engineered from metal to ensure that it gives your files an extra dimension of physical protection against accidental knocks.

result.paraphrase: The Cruzer Force 32GB USB flash drive features a smart grey-and-red finish that looks appealing at first glance. Its metal outer casing is designed to provide added physical protection for your files against accidental bumps.
